question: T can complete a work in 20 days and U can complete the same work in 10 days. If both of them work together, then in 4 days what percent work of the total work will be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

T can complete the work in 20 days.

U can complete the work in 10 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by T in 1 day = 1/20

Work done by U in 1 day = 1/10

Work done by both in 1 day = Work done by T in 1 day + Work done by U in 1 day

Total work done in given days = Work done by both in 1 day × number of days

Percentage of total work completed = (Total work done in given days / Total work) × 100
